test_case.test_name: DDR5 PMIC current-limiter warning state validation
test_case.purpose: For each authorized PMIC/rail, inject one safe synthetic limiter-warning state, prove whether the approved state is warning-only rather than clamp/trip, and restore rail delivery and memory without unapproved reset.
required_package: Vendor railtype11/parameter and warning-clamp-trip state definitions
Approved severity/reset policy, thresholds, hysteresis, latch and clear timing
Calibrated current/voltage/thermal safety and abort limits
Complete tuple command, durable oracle and restoration procedure
test_case.test_command: Do not execute the split tuple or create physical overcurrent. After approval, baseline raw limiter state and calibrated electrical/thermal/memory data; issue one mapped synthetic warning stimulus once; capture state and telemetry; clear by the signed method and prove rails and memory restored before another target.
test_case.expected_result: Only the authorized limiter-warning state asserts, measured current remains below clamp/trip and component limits, reset behavior matches policy, fresh target-specific evidence appears, and after clear all state, rails, thermals, DIMMs, memory and configuration return to baseline.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires authoritative state decoding, calibrated boundary margin, exact target and complete deassert/recovery. Generic logs, active clamp/trip, unsafe current/droop/temperature, unexpected reset, stale state or memory error fails.
safety_gate: Synthetic warning stimulus only; no physical overcurrent.
Independent OOB and calibrated current/voltage/thermal capture.
One target/parameter once; abort on clamp, trip, droop, overheating, reset, I2C loss or memory error.
No automatic clear, retry or traversal.
expected_evidence: Signed railtype11 and warning/clamp/trip state machine
Raw status plus calibrated electrical/thermal/memory baseline
Exact tuple and synchronized one-shot state timeline
Fresh PMIC/CPER/SEL evidence with zero clamp/trip delta
Approved clear, stable rails/thermals, full DIMM/memory and restoration diff
test_case.recovery: Remove only the approved synthetic stimulus, preserve status, then clear through the documented PMIC method. Restore recovery/mode, SPD/telemetry, I2C and BIOS/HDT; verify no clamp/trip latch, stable rails and all memory. Do not retry if protection actuated.

source_conflict.reason: Fatal/correctable warning language, undefined warning-versus-clamp state and one fixed tuple for all targets remain unresolved.

blocked.reason: An incorrect limiter stimulus can actively clamp a memory rail, trip power, reset the host or corrupt memory.
